description: Allowlists for the Library anti-dupe CI gate. New file-home tables, coverage/framework/scheme twin tables, documents-like free-text standards columns, and Python SPA document URL builders outside href_registry must not grow without an explicit baseline edit in the same PR.

file_home_tables.carbon_evidence: Planet Mark evidence home (converge later via F-7 / W-I′)
file_home_tables.controlled_document_versions: Control-layer version blobs (fold later; not a new SoT)
file_home_tables.controlled_documents: Control-layer file pointer (fold later; not a new SoT)
file_home_tables.evidence_assets: Investigation / case evidence blobs (link via documents.id later)
file_home_tables.policy_versions: Legacy policy version file pointer (converge later)

coverage_twin_table_allowlist._comment: Tables whose names match *coverage* / *framework* / *scheme*. CEL SoT is compliance_evidence_links (does not match). Add only with owner + reason if a legitimate non-twin lands.
coverage_twin_table_allowlist.competence_coverage_quotas: CB-PR5 (owner: David Harris). Headcount cover, not evidence cover: how many appointed first aiders / fire marshals / MHFAs a location must keep, counted from the Atlas training matrix. It holds no standard, clause, control or evidence link, so it cannot twin compliance_evidence_links — CEL stays the SoT for what a document covers.

documents_like_freetext_allowlist._comment: table.column pairs of free-text standards/clause columns on documents-like models. Empty on tip — use CEL / clauses FK instead.
